role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 战士的神明玛尔斯在冲突的中心傲然挺立，在致命的坚盾掩护之下他传奇的战矛刺穿敌人。在余烬军团的忠实成员环绕的竞技场中，他陶醉于对手的决战之中，而他们将确保无人可以临阵脱逃，而不论他面临何种危机，战神都能化险为夷，因为他知道众人都站在他这边。
hero_summary_en: The warrior deity Mars thrives in the heart of strife, guarded by the bulk of a deadly shield as he skewers enemies with his legendary spear. He revels in facing opponents in an arena ringed with loyal spearmen—who guarantee that no one escapes and that whatever odds he's facing, the god of war can dictate the terms of battle knowing the crowd is forever on his side.

abilities.name: mars_spear
abilities.description_zh: 玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
notes_zh: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。
notes_en: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.

shard_loc.en: Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
shard_loc.zh: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多%max_impale_targets%名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

abilities.name: mars_gods_rebuke
abilities.description_zh: 玛尔斯举起他的战盾粉碎前方的敌人，将他们击退并且基于自身攻击力造成致命一击伤害。攻击英雄时攻击伤害提升。具有克敌机先效果。
abilities.description_en: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
notes_zh: 神之谴戒的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。
notes_en: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

abilities.name: mars_bulwark
abilities.description_zh: 每当玛尔斯受到来自正面或侧面的攻击时，他就挥舞他那面巨大的战盾来格挡一定百分比的伤害。可以开启，开启后获得相位移动状态，但无法攻击，自身锁定为面朝的方向，并且移动速度降低，但飞向队友的攻击弹道中%redirect_chance%%%将改变方向朝他飞去。
abilities.description_en: Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides. Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs %redirect_chance%%% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
notes_zh: 改向只会在弹道目标位于玛尔斯身后锥形区域内或他身边100范围内才会生效。
破坏会使正面和侧面减伤效果失效。
notes_en: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.

scepter_loc.en: Creates %soldier_count% invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 开启护身甲盾后在玛尔斯的两侧共产生%soldier_count%名无敌的士兵。士兵会随着玛尔斯前进，继承全额攻击力和攻击特效并拥有攻击力加成，附带击退和减速效果。敌人在同一时间只会被1名士兵攻击。

abilities.name: mars_dauntless
abilities.description_zh: %radius%范围内敌方英雄数量更多时，玛尔斯就会获得生命恢复，敌人数量越多，生命恢复也越高。
abilities.description_en: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in %radius% radius.

abilities.name: mars_arena_of_blood
abilities.description_zh: 经过短暂的列队时间，玛尔斯召唤出环绕着战士的竞技场，战士们将阻挡敌人的攻击和动向。竞技场内的敌方英雄靠近边缘时将被战矛攻击，受到伤害并被击退。
abilities.description_en: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.

scepter_loc.en: Lowers cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%  of their max health and mana and get a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%  attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. This effect stacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间降低%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，持续时间提升。如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡，玛尔斯和竞技场内所有友军都会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。这个效果可以叠加。

facet_text_en: If Mars is in the Arena when an enemy dies inside of it, he restores %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%% of his max health and mana and gets a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%% attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. Allies inside the Arena receive %allied_reduction_pct%%% of the bonuses.
Arena of Blood obscures vision and enemies within the arena do not share vision with their allies.
facet_text_zh: 如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡时玛尔斯也在竞技场内，他会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得一个%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成效果，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。竞技场内的友军获得%allied_reduction_pct%%%加成效果。
热血竞技场会遮蔽视野，竞技场内的敌人不会与他们的友军共享视野。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_mars_arena_of_blood_hp_regen
talents_raw.name_loc: Arena Of Blood Grants Team +{s:bonus_health_regen} HP Regen
